Name: Leelo's Tuxedo Cat
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a cute tuxedo cat to the game. This cat is based on my cat, Phoebe, pictured below. This cat sprite comes with a unique loaf animation, replacing the normal sleeping animation. Hats are fully functional with this cat sprite![/color]

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Download with a mod manager for automatic installation. For manual installation, download the .zip mod folder into the StardewValley\Mods folder, extract all from the .zip folder into the same filepath (StardewValley\Mods), and you are all set.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This cat sprite serves as a standalone option, but it is also part of mod bundle that comes with a brown tabby cat, a tortoiseshell cat, and an orange cow cat.. See my other mod, Leelo's Cats, to view that bundle.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]You do [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]not[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] need to start a new game. The added cat can be adopted from the start or from Marnie's shop later on.[/color]

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content [/color]


[center][size=4][b]Meet the Model[/b][/size][/center]

[center][img width=400,height=400]https://i.imgur.com/9C3pxMd.jpeg[/img]
Phoebe is a 10 year old tuxedo cat who has had a rough life. She was rescued as a two month old kitten. After a few years, her human dad (her favorite person) passed away. Not too long later, her human mom passed away and she, and her dog and cat siblings, were taken to the local animal shelter. Luckily, Phoebe was adopted by my friend, the daughter of Phoebe's human parents. She loves drinking from the sink, getting brushed with a hairbrush, laying in the sun, and treats. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Requires SMAPI and content patcher for full integration.[/color]
